chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Yahya ibn Yasar, who said:

We performed Hajj and passed by Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), so he said: 'Hajj of the House of Allah, and Ziyarah of the grave of His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and the Shia of the Family of Muhammad, welcome to you!'

key_terms.شِيعَةُ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The Shia of the Family of Muhammad

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali (as) say to welcome those who performed Hajj and Ziyarah?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) greets Yahya ibn Yasar and other pilgrims, linking the performance of Hajj with the Ziyarah of the Prophet’s grave as a unified act of devotion. This narration underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the spiritual continuity between the pilgrimage to the Kaaba and the visitation of the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the identity of the faithful as 'Shia of the House of Muhammad.' The greeting 'Hani'an' (well done/joyous) signifies divine approval for those who combine ritual worship with love for the Prophet's family.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Yahya Bin Yasaar who said,

‘We performed Hajj and we passed by Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws said: ‘You have performed Hajj of the House of Allahazwj, and Ziyarah of the grave of the Prophetsaww, and Shiahs of the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww welcome to you all!’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Asbat from Yahya ibn Yasar who has said the following:

“We performed al-Hajj. We then visited abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam. He (the Imam) said, ‘Welcome, visitors of the House of Allah, visitors of the grave of His prophet and followers of the family of Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, wholesome and delightful indeed are your visits.’”
